source_text:
[id0]Elena did not sell the violin.

At seven, she whispered, "A fine victory," and shut the door.

She waited for Pavel.[id1]
legitimate_candidate:
[id0]Elena no vendió el violín.

A las siete, susurró: «Una hermosa victoria», y cerró la puerta.

Esperó a Pavel.[id1]
